description: ACCDB: seed T(ID PK, D DATETIME2, D2 DATETIME2) with boundary values + 7th-digit pair + Null; test WHERE and projected =, <, >, BETWEEN against ISO string literals, #date# literals, and column D2 through both DAO and ADO.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, D DATETIME2, D2 DATETIME2)
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D = '2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234567' ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D = '0001-01-01 00:00:00.0000000' ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D = #1899-12-30# ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D < '2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234568' ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D > '2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234567' ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D BETWEEN '1899-12-30 00:00:00.0000000' AND '2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234567' ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D = D2 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D < D2 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D > D2 ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID, D = D2 AS eq_col, D < D2 AS lt_col, D > D2 AS gt_col, D = '2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234567' AS eq_lit, D BETWEEN '1899-12-30 00:00:00.0000000' AND '2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234567' AS bt_lit FROM T ORDER BY ID
